instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Bosnian tweet convey: positive, neutral or negative?
instructions.rule: Negative needs clear distress, anger, insult, sadness or a genuinely harmful event. Everyday gripes, hyperbolic jokes, puzzled questions, quotes or lyrics and wry self-observations are neutral. Shared news, promos and announcements about constructive, pleasant or community topics (sport, culture, education, events, products, services) are positive even when written flatly. Bare data, check-ins and laugh-only replies or banter with emoticons are neutral.

neutral.what: Bare facts, check-ins, vote counts, banter, laugh-only replies, puzzled questions, quotes, lyrics, everyday gripes and hyperbolic jokes without real distress.
examples: I'm at Radon Plaza Hotel (Sarajevo, Bosnia)
Ne mogu više ovih čajeva,bešika će da mi eksplodira. (Can't take more teas, my bladder will explode.)
Kako objasniti to da neko zivi u Njemackoj godinama i pise StuDgart????????? (How to explain someone living in Germany for years writing StuDgart?)
@MilicaDujovic HAHAHAHAHHAHA, UPRAVOO, EE (HAHAHA, exactly)
neutral.cues: I'm at, ?, zašto (why), ko normalan (who in their right mind), umrem/umirem in jokes (I'm dying), haha, :P, ponedjeljak (Monday), +
neutral.not_for: News or ads about pleasant or constructive topics are positive. Clearly harmful events (attacks, crimes, incidents) are negative.

positive.what: Joy, love, praise, enthusiasm, warm wishes, or links, ads and announcements about constructive, pleasant or beneficial things.
examples: Danas počinje skijanje na Vlašiću (Skiing starts today on Vlašić)
Sutra počinje radna sedmica, započnite je slobodnog uma, bez stresa - pridružite nam se na Bodybalance u 18h! (Start the week stress-free, join us at Bodybalance at 6pm!)
Koja gotiva danas prva dva casa na sekciji, i sad peti nemam ma ee uzivanjeee (What fun today, and no fifth class, enjoyment!)
Ne znam za vas, ali ja jedva čekam snijeg. (I can't wait for snow.)
positive.cues: volim (I love), jedva čekam (can't wait), uživanje (enjoyment), gotiva (fun), počinje (starts), nagrađena (awarded), podrška (support), prijatno (enjoy), <3
positive.not_for: Replies that are just laughter or emoticons (HAHAHA, :P, xD) without warmth are neutral. Sad content with a :) at the end is negative.

negative.what: Real anger, insults, heartbreak, sadness, loneliness, jealousy, disgust, or headlines about harmful events.
examples: tuga da tuznije ne moze biti. (sadness, couldn't be sadder)
I opet ko god te spomene mene srce puca. Ali ne dam da se to prmjeti :) (Whenever someone mentions you my heart breaks, but I hide it)
Incident u Trebinju (Incident in Trebinje)
negative.cues: jebem (f***), mrzim (I hate), tuga (sadness), srce puca (heart breaks), placem (I cry), glupe (stupid), kilnuću (I'll kill), :(
negative.not_for: Exaggerated complaints about tiredness, food, study or weather, said as a joke, are neutral.
